patthana8.46:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca na no upādā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na upādā dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādā ca na no upādā ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.46:2.1: …pe… hetuyā pañca. na upādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.46:3.1: na anupādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anupādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na anupādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na anupādinnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno ca na anupādinnā ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. na upādinnaṃ ca na anupādinnaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na upādinno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
